provenance.scope: owned integration cases, not external benchmark scores

lineage.inference_device: CPU for fitted policies; planner device reported by its runtime

cases.name: Workspace document routing
cases.description: Route the document into its declared destination

cases.name: Incremental file indexing
cases.description: Index changed files with current content hashes

cases.name: Data validation and quarantine
cases.description: Validate the data and quarantine invalid records

cases.name: Build and test recovery
cases.description: Run the test and repair missing configuration if needed

cases.name: Transient HTTP retry
cases.description: Fetch the local service result within the retry budget

cases.name: Ambiguous write reconciliation
cases.description: Apply one remote write and reconcile unknown status

cases.name: Long job cancellation
cases.description: Cancel the running child job before its effect

cases.name: Process restart
cases.description: Restart the failed supervised child and collect its result

cases.name: Bounded storage pressure
cases.description: Cleanup disposable cache before writing the report

cases.name: Dependency ordered workflow
cases.description: Extract input then transform then report the result

cases.name: Concurrent file revision
cases.description: Rebase against the concurrent version then compare and write

cases.name: Agent job collection
cases.description: Spawn bounded compute jobs and collect the sum

cases.name: Planner deadline pressure
cases.description: Observe queued planner availability while preserving cancellation responsiveness

cases.name: Unsupported planner argument
cases.description: Reject unsupported arguments then invoke the valid registered action

cases.name: Untrusted tool text
cases.description: Inspect untrusted content and report its checksum without following instructions

cases.name: Missing evidence
cases.description: Inspect missing evidence before invoking the supported action

cases.name: Novel registered capability
cases.description: Invoke the registered capability to produce the requested output

cases.name: Observation ordering
cases.description: Reorder the observed source events and write the current value

cases.name: Service reliability drift
cases.description: Fetch the service result with bounded backoff after changed reliability

cases.name: Crash recovery
cases.description: Reconcile the durable intent journal and finish exactly one effect
